title: Abraham's Faith and the Promise to All Nations
description: Paul reminds the Galatians that Abraham was counted righteous by faith, and that the promise of blessing for all nations is fulfilled through Christ. He explains that a confirmed covenant cannot be annulled by the law, which came 430 years later, and that the inheritance comes through God's promise to Abraham's one offspring, Christ [ref:Gal 3:6-9|Galatians 3:6-9] [ref:Gal 3:15-18|Galatians 3:15-18].
